verification.method: independently recomputed Node latency quantiles from raw integer samples; cross-checked counts, protocol and resources

limits: Synthetic paced SSE, not actual model inference or a maximum-capacity benchmark.
Single shared H2 connection; 128 workers include queueing under the advertised 100-stream connection limit.
No slow-consumer, failure injection, configuration/drain-under-load, WebSocket/gRPC load or long soak result.
Gateway process reused across cases; end RSS and process-lifetime HWM are distinct measurements.
